flows.name: Execute, observe, deduplicate, and cancel
steps: Submit one authenticated read-only assistant command
Repeat the same client message ID
Observe and cancel a separate running turn
flows.expectedOutcome: The AI SDK stream is preserved, history is linked once, duplicate generation is suppressed, and cancellation remains terminal.

claims.description: The authenticated public route preserves the production AI SDK stream.
A running receipt is observable and a duplicate command reuses the same receipt.
Exactly one user and one assistant history row link to the durable turn.
Cancellation and invalid transitions are explicit and fail loudly.
The restored base and incremental hardening migrations are applied.
